scenes.summary: Danger lies ahead. Make sure you are fully prepared before advancing.

lines.text: Endmin, we're getting closer to Nefarith...
A terrible battle may be inevitable... We should be fully prepared before we approach the Landbreakers.

scenes.summary: Perlica is worried about your safety.

lines.text: ...Oh, Endmin... I'm sorry. I was just ... thinking about a few things.
Yes, I was... I was thinking about how to dissuade you from taking on further risks...
Yes... And we might be facing powerful enemies like that in the future... I'm trying to think of a way to guarantee your safety.
I don't have any ideas right now... But I'll try to come up with one after we solve the crisis on our hands.

options: The fight with the giant Aggelos affected you.

lines.text: Tata! Are you fully juiced and ready to go? Let's take a photo together!
Of course it's meaningful! Look at this place! It's like the prettiest place for miles around! We gotta take a picture or this would be one wasted trip!
Totally! Now let me think of a proper pose... Hmm. This gesture looks great... Maybe I can use another pose...
Sure. I also believe we should rest here for a while. Let's move out once everyone's ready.

options: Not yet. Give me some time.
